g.textArea: 100 units, 10,000 simultaneous buyers. Correctness must survive retries and service failures.

rect.data-content: 10,000 concurrent logical buyers
100-unit fixed allocation
95% payments succeed; 5% fail
2% duplicate attempts; Order down30s

g.textArea: Strict: no oversell or duplicate charge. Targets: latency, availability and 500k edge demand.

rect.data-content: Functional: discovery through delivery
Safety: available + held + sold = allocation
Targets and assumptions explicitly labelled
AI-assisted proposal; human team review required

g.textArea: Compare SQL, optimistic CAS, row locks, Redis Lua, queue writer, hybrid. Select admission + SQL + outbox.

rect.data-content: Conditional SQL: short durable critical section
Optimistic CAS: hot-key retry amplification
Redis authority: failover durability burden
Queue every Buy: delayed ownership and status UX
Hybrid selected; single hot-row limit accepted

g.textArea: Held + sold <=100; request dedup, guarded UPDATE and atomic COMMIT.

g.textArea: Eight decisions: concurrency, datastore, cache, messaging, payment, consistency, order recovery, idempotency.

ADR003-004: advisory cache; outbox/inbox messaging
ADR005-006: pinned UNKNOWN; local ACID + eventual views
